errors: unexpected assertion throws FixtureFailure with ClosedCheck, AssertionFile basename and AssertionLine; never persist arbitrary exception messages or objects
originalVariant: same API and companion bytes; no helper lookup, admission or stage assertions
privateVariant: strict helper admission/stage checks after setup; first-business canaries occur before any helper Ready/reflection
